observations.body: Priests place the ark in the inner sanctuary; the only contents named are the two tablets Moses placed there at Horeb when covenant was made after Egypt.
observations.label: The Horeb tablets rest inside the temple ark

observations.body: 1 Kings 8:6–9 supplies later-memory evidence for the event’s developing sequence.
observations.label: Within the Sinai event

observations.body: Later witnesses select and reuse Sinai in their own settings; they remain later readings rather than replacements for the Exodus event.

payload.posture: Read 1 Kings 8:6–9 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: The Horeb tablets rest inside the temple ark belongs to the sinai remembered movement, but its part in the event must remain distinct from the surrounding speech, response, breach, and renewal.
